meta.title: Sessions board
meta.description: Replaces the sidebar's workspace browser with a live agentbar-style board: four sections — Needs you, Running, Recent, Sleeping — one compact row per Session with a status glyph, its title, and how long ago it changed. The sections are evaluated in that order, so state outranks age: an approval left pending for days stays in Needs you, and a long turn stays in Running. A quiet Session with no update for 12 hours falls into Sleeping; the threshold is the SLEEP_AFTER_MS constant in client.js. The glyph separates shapes as well as colors — ? pending, a pulsing dot while work runs, ✓ finished, · idle, ○ sleeping — so state does not depend on color alone. Selecting a row opens that Session; the collapsed rail keeps one dot per active state. Rows come from the Session list and live status the page already holds, so nothing is read from disk and no model request is made. Enabling it hides the shipped workspace browser, including its search, drag reordering, and Add-workspace controls.
